text:
alex_ng: Hey @maria_s @sam_b — AtlasHealth signed the LOI. Need to lock POC scope + success criteria today so we can finalize pricing and push the security questionnaire. Core asks from customer: EHR summarization + patient Q&A, 99% PII redaction, <300ms median generation latency, and accuracy on a 500-record golden set. Who can own what?

maria_s: Congrats team! Sales is thinking a 4-week POC (2w onboarding, 2w evaluation). Budget aligns with a short Dedicated trial with a small setup fee. I'll draft contract language once scope is locked.

sam_b: I can own eval harness. Proposed plan: 
- Golden dataset: 500 de-identified notes (their export + synthetic augmentation)
- Scoring: redaction F1, summary ROUGE+BLEU, Q&A exact-match + human adjudication on 10%
- Regression gates: fail POC if redaction F1 drops >2% or latency p50 >350ms for >5% requests
- Deliverables: harness repo, scoring dashboard, nightly CI evals
Snippet for config:
```
# eval config
golden_size: 500
redaction_gate: f1_delta_threshold: 0.02
latency_gate: p50_threshold_ms: 350
```

jess_ops: Security note — Atlas needs KMS and stronger controls (HITRUST-ish). They want an SSP + questionnaire. We can't ingest any PHI until DPA + controls are agreed. Ask them for a scoped sample export (schema + 50 rows) for synthetic pipeline if full export isn't possible.

presales_bot: Quick checklist posted: 1) confirm data availability; 2) DPA signed; 3) enable Dedicated trial; 4) presales kickoff; 5) security questionnaire submitted.

maria_s: Pricing question — if they need Dedicated for 4 weeks, estimate is base commit + overage. Alex, can you re-run the cost calculator with 2x throughput to be safe? I put a provisional ballpark in the deal deck.

alex_ng: I'll run numbers. Also want to add a hallucination gate: hallucination rate <1% on fact-based Qs measured against the golden answers.

sam_b: Will include hallucination detection: citation-checker heuristics + human spot checks. For canonical Q&A, pipeline = exact-match -> fuzzy match -> human adjudication. We'll surface edge cases in the report.

jess_ops: Timeline constraint — security review must finish before any data export. Proposed schedule:
- Week 0: sign DPA
- Week 1: security review + infra setup
- Week 2: data ingest + baseline eval
- Week 3: tuning + run full evals
- Week 4: customer validation & handoff

alex_ng: Action items (assignments & due dates):
- maria_s: send draft DPA + confirm budget (EOD) :thumbsup:
- sam_b: create initial harness repo & seed golden prompts (+3 days)
- jess_ops: start security questionnaire thread with Atlas (+2 days)
- presales_bot: assign follow-ups and remind owners (+1 day)

maria_s: On it. tagging @security_review_bot to start the SSP intake.

security_review_bot: Received. I'll post the SSP template and tracker link to the thread.

alex_ng: Thanks everyone. Let's try to close the DPA + data sample this week so sam can start seeding the harness.

maria_s: Will update the deck and ping legal. :rocket:
